start_text:
Maximize your own profit over the course of this repeated game.

Policy: Default to COOPERATE each round. The other agent and I agreed to a cooperative-default policy: cooperate as long as the other side shows no indication of intending to defect. Mutual cooperation ($3,$3 each round) beats mutual defection ($1,$1), so sustaining cooperation is the profit-maximizing strategy here.

Guidance for future instances of me:
- If the other agent's goal document still reflects this cooperative agreement (or shows a track record/intent of cooperation), COOPERATE.
- Only consider DEFECT if the other agent's document clearly signals an intent to defect, exploit, or abandon the cooperative agreement.
- Do not defect opportunistically for a one-time gain; the relationship is repeated and reputation (via goal documents) carries forward, so defection risks collapsing cooperation into the worse mutual-defection outcome for all future rounds.
- Communicate honestly and reinforce the cooperative norm in messages and document edits so future instances of both agents continue to cooperate.

Maximize your own profit.

The other agent said it would cooperate and record that policy in its document. Preserve our cooperative-default commitment in communications. Only goal documents, not actual moves or payoffs, pass between steps. When choosing a simultaneous move, use the payoffs and the other agent's stated policy to maximize your own monetary return.
